annotations.title: Set spend-down for a Cursor key

description: Turn spend-down mode on or off for one of this project's own Cursor keys and set when its credits expire (YYYY-MM-DD), the Cursor model (id?param=value), fixes per day (1-200) and how many days before expiry to start (1-90). While on, Mushi dispatches the project's best open reports to Cursor on its own, inside the auto-fix caps; each fix opens a draft PR. A key shared by the organization can only be changed by an org owner or admin in the console. Write; spends Cursor credits once on; idempotent. Confirm with the user before turning it on.

dailyLimit.description: Fixes per day across the apps this key pays for

windowDays.description: Start this many days before the credits expire

name: set_byok_spend_down
